chunks: Whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask, it is all the same; God will not forgive them. Surely God does not show a disobedient people the way.

key_terms.الْفَاسِقِينَ: The disobedient or those who transgress divine boundaries

ai.seo_question: Why does God not forgive the hypocrites even if the Prophet asks for them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing the limit of prophetic intercession (Shafa'ah), demonstrating that even the Prophet Muhammad’s prayers could not secure forgiveness for the hypocrites if their internal state of 'fasaq' (transgression) remained unchanged. It underscores the principle that divine guidance is contingent upon the individual's spiritual condition rather than merely the status of the supplicant, a concept central to understanding the balance between divine decree and human agency.
